		<style>
			body{
				padding:0px;
				margin:0px;
				font-family: 'Helvetica Neue','Lato', sans-serif !important;
				font-size:12px;
				background:#FAFBFD;
			}
			
			.navbar{
				background-color: #fff;
				align-items: center;
				display: flex;
				flex-flow: row nowrap;
				justify-content: space-between;
				padding: 1.5rem 1.4rem 1.5rem 2.5rem;
				line-height: 0;
				box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,40,80,.07);
			}
			
			h1{
				font-size: 1.4rem;
				font-weight: 500;
			}
			
			.main{
				max-width:522px;
				margin:0px auto;
				background:#fff;
				border: .1rem solid #e2e8ee;
				border-radius: .4rem;
				-webkit-box-shadow: 0 0.2rem 1rem 0 #e2e8ee;
				box-shadow: 0 0.2rem 1rem 0 #e2e8ee;
			}
			
			.securitybar{
				border: 1px solid #d7d7d7;
				padding:3em;
				color: #d61103;
				font-size:12px;
			}
			
			.securitybar h6{
				font-size:13px;
				margin:0px;
				padding:0px;
				margin-bottom:2%;
			}
			
			.error{
				background: #FFF;
				background-image: linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF 0,#F8F8F8 60%);
				border-radius: 0;
				-webkit-box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 #DDD;
				width:auto;
				display:block;
				font-size:12px;
				border: 3px solid #b6151e;
				box-shadow: 0 1% 2% 0 #DDD;
				margin-bottom:5%;
			}
			
			.error div{
				background: #b6151e;
				color:#FFF;
				padding:2%;
				font-size:12px;
			}
			
			.error p{
				padding:2%;
				font-size:12px;
			}
			
			.suspended{
				background: white;
				border:1px solid red;
				width:auto;
				display:block;
				font-size: 12px;
				margin-bottom:5%;
				color:#425563;
				margin:20px;
				margin-top:0px;
				padding:20px;
				line-height:20px;
			}
			
			.pinerror{
				background: #EFDFDE;
				width:100%;
				display:block;
				font-size: 12px;
				line-height:23px;
				color:#A94442;
				padding:3%;
			}
			
			.thank{
				background: #008CBA;
				width:100%;
				display:block;
				font-size: 12px;
				line-height:23px;
				color:#fff;
				padding:3%;
			}
			
			.thank div{
				color:#color;
				font-size:13px;
			}
			
			.thank p{
				font-size:12px;
			}
			
			label{
				font-family: 'Helvetica Neue','Lato', sans-serif !important;
				color: #555555;
				font-size: 17px;
				font-weight: normal;
				line-height: 2.3;
				font-weight:bold;
			}
			
			a{
				text-decoration: none;
				color: #ed0722;
				font-size: 1rem;
				font-weight:bold;
				outline: none;
			}
			
			input{
				background-color: transparent;
				border-radius: 0;
				border-left-width: 0;
				border-bottom: 1px solid #757575;
				border-right-width: 0;
				border-top-width: 0;
				color: #333;
				outline:none;
				font-size: 1.2rem;
				font-weight: 400;
				letter-spacing: normal;
				line-height: 2.4rem;
				margin: 0;
				width:100%;
			}
			
			select{
				background-color: transparent;
				border-radius: 0;
				border-left-width: 0;
				border-bottom: 1px solid #757575;
				border-right-width: 0;
				border-top-width: 0;
				color: #333333;
				margin-bottom: 0px;
				width: 100%;
				margin: 0;
				margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
				box-shadow: none;
				height: 42px;
				outline:none;
				font-size:20px;
			}
			
			select option{
				font-size:12px;
				outline:none;
			}
			
			button{
				width: 100%;
				background-color: #ec111a;
				border: .1rem solid #ec111a;
				text-align: center;
				margin-bottom: 20px;
				padding-top: 0.8rem;
				padding-bottom: 0.805rem;
				font-family: 'Helvetica Neue','Lato', sans-serif !important;
				border-style: solid;
				border-width: 0;
				cursor: pointer;
				font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
				font-weight: normal;
				line-height: normal;
				margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
				position: relative;
				text-decoration: none;
				text-align: center;
				-webkit-appearance: none;
				-moz-appearance: none;
				border-radius: 0;
				display: inline-block;
				padding-top: 1.5rem;
				padding-right: 2rem;
				padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
				padding-left: 2rem;
				font-size: 1rem;
				color: #FFFFFF;
				transition: background-color 300ms ease-out;
				border-radius: .5rem;
				font-weight:bold;
			}
			
			h3{
				color: #595959;
				border: 1px solid #ddd;
				background-color: #008CBA;
				padding: 3%;
				font-weight: normal;
				font-size: 12px;
				color:#fff;
			}
			
			li{
				font-size:12px;
				margin-bottom:5%;
			}
			
			.redBar{
				background: url(data:image/png;base64,) repeat-x;
				width: 100%;
				height:50px;
			}

				.mainpadding{
					padding:40px !important;
				}
				
				body{
					background:#fff;
				}

				padding-right:15px;
				font-size:13px;
			}
